We need to determine crimes based on facts. The facts: In 2014, Zhang blocked construction, was stopped by Wang, Zhang called his son Li, Li saw Zhang on ground, slapped Wang. Then Wang instructed workers to beat Li, causing Li light injury (一级轻伤). After Li injured, Wang to evade law, found Ren, instructed Ren to make false testimony of intentional injury, promised 10k per month. Also Wang instructed workers Wang Jia, Han to go to police station to make false testimony that Ren beat Li, leading to Ren being detained for suspected crime.

Thus crimes: Wang's actions: (1) Intentional injury (故意伤害) causing light injury. (2) Organizing, forcing, inducing others to commit intentional injury? He directed workers to beat Li. That could be "组织、领导、教唆他人实施犯罪" maybe "组织、教唆故意伤害罪". Also he induced false testimony: "伪证罪" (making false statements to police). Also possibly "妨害司法公正" or "伪证罪" (providing false testimony). The text says "指使任某某作实施故意伤害的伪证" i.e., instructing false testimony about intentional injury. So crime: "伪证罪". Also "故意伤害罪". Possibly also "聚众斗殴"? But it's directed assault.
